headline: Proposed annual stipend for School Committee members, plus three grants and two donations of reclaimed lab equipment.
summary: Members will vote on recommending an annual stipend to the City Council, with the dollar amount left blank on the agenda. Other votes cover accepting donations from NLS ReSource, Inc. and three grants, including one for $28,800.
